messages:
alex: heads-up – I'm seeing a steady drop in prefix cache hit-rate for the /v1/generate route since the 2am deploy. alerts started firing. anyone know which dashboard we should look at?
lucy: grafana panel is under Observability > KV Cache > Prefix hit-rate. link: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/kv_cache/prefix-hitrate?orgId=1
sam: +1 that panel shows per-shard breakdown. watch the rolling-5m series.
alex: thanks. can we also get the logs/traces to see if it's a change in request patterns or backing store noise?
lucy: logs: Kibana -> Logs > kv-cache-access. query: `service:kv-cache AND route:"/v1/generate" AND status:200`
sam: traces: use Tempo traces from the same timeframe, filter span `kv.lookup` and group by `prefix_key`. Usually low hit-rate maps to increased `cache.miss` spans.
alex: the alert is noisy — it fires a lot for shard-3 during batch jobs. what's the current Prometheus rule?
dashbot: Alert firing: KVPrefixCacheHitRateLow (firing: 3/3).
ops-oncall: rule is in prometheus/kvm.rules: `alert: KVPrefixCacheHitRateLow
expr: avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hit_rate{job=\"kv-service\"}[5m]) < 0.55
for: 10m
labels: {severity: \"critical\"}`
lucy: that 0.55 looks conservative for batch-heavy windows. we should avoid flapping during nightly batch runs.
sam: propose: add a `job=~"realtime|api"` label to the alert so it ignores `batch` jobs, or raise threshold to 0.5 and increase `for` to 15m.
alex: option 1 sounds safer: ignore batch. where's the dashboard that flags batch windows?
lucy: there's a panel in the same dashboard called `ingest: job-type` with a legend. you can pivot on `job` label.
ops-oncall: I can open a PR for the alert rule change (add `job=~"realtime|api"` and set `for: 15m`). will link when ready.
alex: sweet. also, can we add a small note in the dashboard description explaining the threshold and why batch is excluded? saves pings.
lucy: will add a widget and short blurb. cc @sam for wording.
sam: ack — I'll review the PR and double-check shard-3 config (it has a different eviction policy).
alex: thanks all. ping me in this thread when PR is up, and I'll coordinate canary changes to shard-3.
